title: Register kartka, leetcode and todoimpl in app_icons
objective: The app_icons generator can regenerate the family icons kartka, leetcode-guard/app and todoImplementer/app already ship, with the same glyph shape, accent and field.
acceptance_criteria: apps.get_app returns kartka, leetcode and todoimpl with glyph, icon_name and linux flag taken from disk facts
Each renders the standard 1024px svg+png layer set into a temp dir without error; linux-flagged ones render the hicolor sizes
Regenerated icon.png matches the shipped one side by side
out_of_scope: betting_sim's dead registry path and the shared track-bars glyph
